_publications._publicationTitle: Non-obese diabetic-recombination activating gene-1 (NOD-Rag1 null) interleukin (IL)-2 receptor common gamma chain (IL2r gamma null) null mice: a radioresistant model for human lymphohaematopoietic engraftment
_publications._context: Original description of the NOD-Rag1null IL2rgnull (NRG) strain as a radioresistant recipient for human lymphohematopoietic engraftment.

NRG mice used as immunodeficient xenograft hosts for NF1;Ink4a MPNST tumor models (JH002 human MPNST xenografts) in Steven Rhodes' group (Indiana University), per Jira NFOSI-308 / Synapse syn25999248. Requested as a modelSystemName vocabulary addition in nf-metadata-dictionary#205.

basicInfo.description: Extremely immunodeficient mouse strain (Rag1 and Il2rg double null) used as a xenograft recipient; carries no disease phenotype of its own but is the standard host strain for engrafting human NF1-associated tumor cells (e.g. MPNST xenografts).

mutationTypes: Combined Rag1 and Il2rg null mutations (double knockout)
